description_excerpt: Our impact begins here As Business Development Specialist, Pharmacy Chains and E-health, you will build the partnerships that help more people in Vietnam start and stay on treatment. You will turn Novo’s brand and commercial strategies into account plans and agreements with pharmacy chains and e-health partners, using data to decide the next best action. Your work will strengthen Novo’s competitive position and improve support for people living with serious chronic diseases.
